mapper.select: SELECT id, subbarcode AS subbarcode, sample_name AS sampleName, order_no AS orderNo, scheme_no AS studyNo, project_no AS projectNo, subject_no AS participantNo, research_center AS center, receive_confirm_time AS receiveDate, sample_type AS sampleType, sample_quantity AS sampleCount, product_name AS product, customer_name AS customerName, report_email AS reportEmail FROM cms_sample WHERE subbarcode = #{subbarcode} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT subbarcode, sample_name AS sampleName, sample_type AS sampleType, sample_quantity AS sampleCount FROM cms_sample WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY id
SELECT tenant_id FROM cms_sample WHERE subbarcode = #{subbarcode} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT n.id AS lastNotifyId, n.subbarcode AS subbarcode, n.sample_name AS sampleName, n.sample_file_id AS sampleFileId, n.notify_type AS notifyType, n.wet_lab_qc_id AS wetLabQcId, n.bioinfo_qc_id AS bioinfoQcId, n.notify_no AS notifyNo, n.notify_status AS notifyStatus, n.sign_status AS signStatus, n.analysis_time AS analysisTime, n.product AS product, n.customer_name AS customerName, n.sample_type AS sampleType, n.qc_stage AS qcStage, n.terminate_measure AS terminateMeasure, n.remedy AS remedy, n.reason AS reason, n.delay_reason AS delayReason, n.expected_report_date AS expectedReportDate, n.remedy_other AS remedyOtherText, n.reporter AS reporter, n.report_time AS reportTime, n.reviewer AS reviewer, n.review_time AS reviewTime, n.raw_docx_path AS lastDocxName, n.pdf_path AS lastPdfName, n.sign_contract_id AS signContractId, n.signed_pdf_path AS signedPdfPath, DATE_FORMAT(n.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastGeneratedAt, TRUE AS `generated` -- generated 是 MySQL 保留字，别名必须反引号 FROM sample_notify n WHERE n.subbarcode = #{subbarcode} AND n.notify_type = #{notifyType} AND n.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT cc_email FROM project_config WHERE project_no = #{projectNo} AND parent_id = 0 AND del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1

SELECT c.receive_email FROM project_config p JOIN project_config c ON c.project_no = p.project_no AND c.parent_id = p.id AND c.del_flag = '0' WHERE p.project_no = #{projectNo} AND p.parent_id = 0 AND p.del_flag = '0' AND c.research_center_name = #{centerName} LIMIT 1
